note: The SO(3) Schur argument is correct. Time derivatives d_t commute with SO(3) and act as scalars, so the full operator O(d_t, d_i, eta) is SO(3)-covariant despite involving spacetime derivatives. The no-cross-terms conclusion follows from Schur orthogonality for the SO(3)-invariant bilinear form. Minor imprecision: the statement should specify SO(3)-equivariance of O and that the integral provides the SO(3)-invariant bilinear form, but the logic is sound.
